objective.name: Zero-sum Orthogonal Rows
objective.goal: Make a wide matrix with nonzero pairwise orthogonal rows, every row sum 0, and no zero columns. Equivalently, A1ₙ = 0 and AAᵀ is diagonal with positive diagonal entries, where 1ₙ is the column vector of n ones.
objective.check: Both row sums are 0, their dot product is 0, and AAᵀ = diag(2,6). No column is zero.
objective.note: This intentionally strengthens C12 by putting the all-ones vector in the nullspace. Wide shape is necessary: independent zero-sum rows lie in an (n−1)-dimensional subspace.

history.note: The starting matrix is square, while the objective requires a wide shape; this hand has no append operation, and I cannot see a useful first move toward that shape.
